title: Colony Bank Welcomes Clark Bowers as Commercial Banker in Statesboro
summary: Phillip Anderson joins Colony Bank as Savannah Market President, leading its banking team in Savannah, Georgia.
body_markdown:
Colony Bank is pleased to announce the addition of Clark Bowers as Vice President, Commercial Banker in Statesboro, Georgia.


Bowers brings 19 years of banking experience to Colony Bank, including the past seven years with Truist, where he most recently served as Senior Relationship Banker. Throughout his career, he has built a strong reputation for developing lasting business relationships, understanding his customers’ needs, and delivering financial solutions that help businesses grow and succeed.


“There’s a lot of exciting growth happening in Statesboro, and we see tremendous opportunity ahead,” said Wesley Olliff, Coastal Georgia President for Colony Bank. “I’ve known Clark for years, and he’s the kind of banker we want on our team. He knows this community, cares about its success, and brings the experience to help local businesses thrive. His addition strengthens our ability to deliver the personal service and trusted advice that members of our community need as this market continues to grow.”


A Bulloch County native, Bowers attended Auburn University and is a member of First Baptist Church Statesboro. He and his wife, Cindy, have two daughters.


Colony Bank serves the Statesboro community through its banking center located at 104 Springhill Drive, offering a comprehensive range of personal and business banking services. For businesses, the bank combines commercial lending, treasury management, merchant services, and other financial solutions with a consultative approach focused on understanding each customer’s needs and long-term goals.
